objective: Test whether continuous ranking scores preserve equal predictive utility across different representation geometries and still separate a materially weaker representation.
scope: Experiment-only synthetic mechanism diagnostic. It changes no public OverlapIndex or Vertebrae behavior and promotes no method.

data.latent_contract: All candidates in a panel share U, target noise, and base nuisance rows. For quality q, Z=U+sqrt(1/q^2-1)*eta. Direct, rotated, anisotropic, and signed-product encodings all retain Z exactly.
data.analytic_truth: R2(E[Y|X])=q^2/(1+0.35^2), invariant to the four invertible geometry encodings.

reference_heads.preprocessing: StandardScaler fitted inside every inner fold and refit on the complete training cohort
reference_heads.envelope: maximum held-out R2 across the four tuned families
reference_heads.purpose: Measure finite-head accessibility separately from analytic information equality.

metrics.matched_score_range: maximum minus minimum score across the four q=.85 candidates
metrics.material_pair_accuracy: fraction of four q=.85 versus signed_q55 comparisons ordered correctly; score ties receive half credit
metrics.analytic_selection_regret_r2: best analytic R2 minus analytic R2 of selected score maximum
metrics.finite_head_envelope_regret_r2: best held-out head-envelope R2 minus envelope R2 of selected score maximum
metrics.head_envelope_matched_spread_r2: maximum minus minimum held-out envelope R2 across the four analytically matched candidates

interpretation.score_geometry_bias: matched score range exceeds 0.05 in at least 75 percent of panels
interpretation.harmful_geometry_failure: the weaker candidate is selected in more than 10 percent of panels or mean material-pair accuracy is below 0.90
interpretation.finite_head_accessibility_difference: held-out head-envelope spread among analytically matched candidates exceeds 0.02 R2
interpretation.no_promotion: The panel diagnoses a mechanism; it cannot promote or tune a method.

artifact_contract.checkpoint: one atomic JSON per dimension/sample-size/training-seed panel
artifact_contract.resume: exact source and protocol hashes only
